title: Early Cancellation Settlement Terms
content:
A customer cancels a Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans plan by submitting a cancellation request; the plan is cancelled when the request is settled. A cancellation that does not receive the free-look full refund is settled by the plan's cancellation settlement rule, which is the same under all six plans: the list value of services used in the current term less the plan fees paid in the current term.

**Settlement clause.** The customer owes the list value of services used in the current term, less the plan fees paid in the current term, plus the cancellation processing fee, when that amount is positive. The amount is rounded to the cent. When it is zero or below, nothing is owed. When fees paid exceed the value used, nothing is refunded unless the plan refunds fees paid in excess of services used, which none of the six plans does. When the pet has died, the balance owed is waived where the plan waives it on the pet's death, and no processing fee is charged.

## Definitions

- **List value of services used in the current term** — the total of the list values recorded on the redemptions of the current term, less the list values of redemptions voided.
- **Plan fees paid in the current term** — the total of the plan fee charges of the current term other than the enrollment fee, less any fees refunded. A monthly fee and a paid-in-full term charge both count; the enrollment fee does not.
- **Current term** — from the term start to the term end of the plan being cancelled.

## Settlement terms by plan

| Plan | Cancellation processing fee | Excess fees refunded | Balance waived when the pet has died |
|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 25.00 USD | No | Yes |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | 25.00 USD | No | Yes |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 25.00 USD | No | Yes |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 25.00 USD | No | Yes |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 25.00 USD | No | Yes |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | 25.00 USD | No | Yes |

## Worked settlements (hypothetical term records)

| Case | Value used | Fees paid | Value used less fees paid, plus 25.00 | Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 264.80 | 139.80 | 150.00 | Customer owes 150.00 |
| B | 200.00 | 190.00 | 35.00 | Customer owes 35.00 |
| C | 64.95 | 209.70 | below zero | Nothing owed, nothing refunded |
| D, pet has died | 264.80 | 139.80 | balance waived, no processing fee | Nothing owed |
| E | 100.00 | 110.00 | 15.00 | Customer owes 15.00 |

In case B the value used is higher than the fees paid, and the processing fee is added to the difference. In case E the fees paid exceed the value used by 10.00, yet adding the processing fee leaves a positive amount, so the customer owes it. In case C the fees paid exceed the value used, and since no plan refunds the excess, the settlement is nothing either way. In case D the pet's death waives the balance owed and removes the processing fee, so the settlement is nothing owed.
